title: Spec: GCP-7.1 handoff COSE_Sign1 protected-header example bytes show decoy alg -65536
description: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md lines 295 and 334 (GCP-7.1 Handoff Request and Handoff Confirm COSE_Sign1 examples) still show h'a10139ffff', which decodes to {1: -65536}, contradicting the stated {1: -65537} on the same lines. Same bug as the one fixed for the GCP-6.5 slot-claim example in project-LICHEN-worker6-nwjl.1 (now h'47A1013A00010000' = bstr-wrapped canonical {1: -65537}; verified with cbor2: canonical map = a1013a00010000, bstr-wrapped = 47a1013a00010000). Fix both handoff examples the same way (bstr-wrapped form, per RFC 9052 and the COSE_Sign1 array in capability_announcements.py which CBOR-encodes the raw protected-map bytes as a bstr). Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-nwjl.1 scope check; deliberately not touched there to keep that bead's 5-change mandate minimal.
